details.costs: One study round and 0.2 energy; each valid atomic examination costs one round and 0.5 energy, with no root or material input/output. Invalid identity, scope, reach or energy does not charge.
details.effects: Private dated report of actual visible geometry, complete conserved source data and implementation applicability. No planting, clearing, resource, reservation, mastery, viability or wellbeing grant. Repeating pays again without reward. No ongoing process or maintenance; cancel/interruption/death before execution has no completed finding; after completion, finding and paid effort persist without refund. Only actual communication can share knowledge.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches.
